title: Fitting Amount on Out-of-Network Glasses Claims, Vision Plans
content:
On a Vision Plans out-of-network claim settled on its glasses part, the fitting amount follows the claim's lines:

| Fitting line on the claim | Fitting amount |
|---|---|
| A specialty contact-lens fitting line | 100.00 |
| A standard contact-lens fitting line | 30.00 |
| No fitting line | No fitting amount (0.00) |

The fitting's kind is read from the fitting line.

*Hypothetical cases.* A specialty fitting receipt of 112.75 meets a fitting amount of 100.00. A standard fitting receipt of 112.75 meets 30.00. A specialty fitting receipt of 84.10 is below the 100.00 amount.
